title: Bedrock spend tripled after release 3.1.0 (prompt caching)
scenario: Daily Bedrock cost for the help desk agent tripled with flat traffic the day release 3.1.0 shipped. Usage logs show cache writes on every turn and no cache reads. On-call blames the minimum cacheable size or the TTL. Find the real cause in the request builder and fix the prompt layout.
task: Read the Converse usage blocks before and after the release
Find what makes the cached prefix differ per request
Move dynamic context after the cache point; stabilise tool order
Show the cost for 100 conversations back under budget
acceptance: Cache reads from turn 2 and across users
Byte-identical prefixes; dynamic data still reaches the model
ANSWER.md rules out the size and TTL theories with evidence
